subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - owners & milestone dates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2024 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration build plan)

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Per our discovery call, I’m sending a short recap and a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the Integration Build Plan (SDK integration, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs).

High-level summary:
- Goal: Ship SDK integration and streaming pipeline for LLM-powered product recommendations in ACME’s web app.
- Target close / go-live for this milestone: 2024-08-15 (internal target, flexible based on procurement).
- Primary dependencies: ACME infra review (network/Egress), SSO + KMS for keys, procurement signature, and API quota approval.

Attached: ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP worksheet with milestones) and integration_arch_sketch.png (high-level flow).

Draft MAP milestone (Integration Build Plan) — owners and rough dates:
1) SDK integration (client-side + server-side) — Owner: ACME (Tom Reynolds), Redwood SE: Vivek Kulkarni — Target: 2024-06-14 — Dependencies: SDK review, CI access.
2) Streaming + KV/prefix caching — Owner: Redwood (Vivek) — Target: 2024-07-05 — Dependencies: perf testing, staging GPU capacity.
3) Tool-calling & structured outputs (order id normalization + fulfillment webhook) — Owner: ACME + Redwood (Tom / Vivek) — Target: 2024-07-20 — Dependencies: webhook spec, auth.
4) E2E validation & quality gates (prompt regression tests + metrics) — Owner: ACME (Sarah) & Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 2024-08-01 — Dependencies: test data and eval set.

Next steps (action items):
- Sarah: confirm owners and any missing dependencies by EOD Wed 4/30.
- Tom: share RFC for webhook + any compliance constraints.
- Vivek: prepare a staging perf checklist and rough timeline for streaming pilot.
- Marissa/Ben: loop in procurement for SOW and timeline for purchase order.

Open questions we flagged: network egress rules (allowlist), KMS/HSM expectations, and whether ACME wants server-side SDK only or also client-side JS.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan - staging needs & streaming checklist

Quick technical note from the SE side — pulling together the pilot checklist this morning. Early answers: 
- Minimum staging capacity for a representative streaming pilot (50 concurrent connections, median request size ~1.2k tokens): we recommend 2x A10G equivalents (or 1x A100 for headroom) with 200GB ephemeral disk for caching and logs.
- Prefix/KV caching: Redwood will manage prefix caching server-side; if ACME wants client-side caching we can provide a JS helper, but we recommend server-side to avoid token leakage.
- KMS: we support using customer-managed keys in AWS KMS. We will need an IAM role to read-decrypt ephemeral encryption keys; we do not require direct long-term access to the KMS root keys.

I’ll attach the pilot checklist and a short perf runbook in a follow-up email by EOD.

—Vivek
